targets.title: Give Me 11 Minutes and You’ll Be a Disgustingly Consistent Trader
targets.author: Tori Trades
targets.text:
🔗 join the waitlist: https://go.toritradez.com/waitlist-1911

i've been trading for 11 years and for the first three i was making every decision live on the chart with real money on the line. overtrading, holding trades that made no sense, telling myself i just needed more discipline. it almost made me quit.

what actually changed things was building systems around my trading so the decisions are already made before i sit down. in this video i walk you through all four so you can take them and plug them into your own trading, whatever strategy you use.
